independent_visible_comparison.original: The original image shows one broad pale icy-blue top plate over a dark blue-gray front block/flange, two very small dark circular fasteners, nearly planar color areas and narrow angular edge bevels. The clean simple identity reads, but the large top surface has little tactile variation and the front fasteners are visually quiet.
independent_visible_comparison.fixed_target: The fixed target retains the broad plate/front flange and paired fastener identity, while giving the edge transitions a visibly rounder continuous roll. It uses a cool desaturated steel field with broad pale highlights, warm golden rim light, substantial hexagonal front fasteners with darker seats, sparse scored scratches and irregular orange-brown worn patches. The warm and cool color separation makes the rounded volume clearer. Its surface weathering is considerably busier and more realistic than the original.
independent_visible_comparison.global_style: The global reference is a vivid green faceted plant in a warm golden-orange pot. Clear large facets, softened pot corners, broad yellow edge highlights, deep but controlled creases and strong separation of the leaf planes establish the warm softly lit cartoon look. It favors readable structural masses over fine repeated texture.
independent_visible_comparison.translation_observations: Useful native opportunities visible in the fixed target are rounded edge thickness, a more deliberate layered plate/flange construction, readable modeled fasteners and selected wear. The global reference suggests keeping those details subordinate to large clean masses and soft broad light. Original weak topology, tiny fasteners, old shader complexity and part counts do not by themselves constrain later design. These are preliminary visual observations, not a frozen criteria list or approval.

variants.visible_read: Broad slanted pale-blue top plate over dark blue-gray block, paired small dark octagonal rivets on front. Thin single-step beveled cube masses; raw camera render visibly more skewed than supplied original image.
A narrower tall dark metal shard/wedge with diagonal top, thick slab depth and two vertically stacked small pale hexagonal bolts. The top plane is medium blue while the front is substantially darker.
Mixed assembly: an orange-brown block at left, taller tilted cool-blue scrap at right and a dark horizontal front brace across both. Its broad warm/cool mass contrast is already distinctive.

bounded_native_observations.topology_materials: Raw meshes are flat-shaded low-count polyhedra. A body/top and C cuboid parts have single-segment Hand-cut bevel modifiers (observed widths 0.008 to 0.022); B shard and bolts have no modifiers. Metal-family blue-gray, light blue-gray and dark navy materials plus a warm wood-named material for C exist. Actual surface links point to Principled BSDF.001, with connected node networks; shader names or original settings are observations rather than aesthetic locks.
